evals.prompt: Our company emits 50,000 tCO2e (Scope 1+2) and we're in the cement sector. We need a credible transition plan for SBTi. Help us build one.
evals.expected_output: Starts with baseline analysis, references cement SBTi pathway, identifies levers (clinker ratio, alternative fuels, CCS).
assertions: References the SBTi cement sector pathway
Identifies sector-specific levers (clinker reduction, alternative fuels)
Mentions CCS as acceptable for cement (hard-to-abate)
Structures output around TPT/ESRS E1-1 framework

evals.prompt: Vogliamo raggiungere il net-zero entro il 2050. Siamo un'azienda di servizi IT. Da dove partiamo con il piano di transizione?
evals.expected_output: Notes IT services has relatively low direct emissions, focuses on Scope 2 (electricity) and Scope 3 (supply chain, travel).
assertions: Identifies Scope 2 (electricity) as main direct lever
Flags Scope 3 (purchased services, travel, commuting) as likely dominant
Mentions renewable energy procurement as primary Scope 2 lever
Explains near-term (2030) vs long-term (2050) target structure
